_template_guidance.item_limit: Use 4-20 items. Maximum supported item count is 20.
_template_guidance.score_range: x_score and y_score must be numbers from 1 to 5. 1 means Low, 5 means High; scores 3-5 are placed on the High side.
_template_guidance.axis_mapping: For value_feasibility, x_score is Technical Feasibility and y_score is Customer Value.
_template_guidance.visible_notes: Use top-level notes only when you want a visible Notes area. Do not add item-level notes.
